question: When was the Reserve Bank of India established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st April 1935**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established on April 1, 1935: 
 
• The RBI was established by the Reserve Bank of India Act, of 1934. 
 
• The RBI was created to respond to economic challenges after World War I. 
 
• The RBI was established based on the recommendations of the 1926 Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance, also known as the Hilton Young Commission. 
 
• Sir Osborne Smith was the first Governor of the RBI. 
 
• The RBI's Central Office was initially in Kolkata but was permanently moved to Mumbai in 1937. 
 
• The RBI's original functions included regulating the issue of banknotes, maintaining reserves, and operating the country's credit and currency system. 
 
• The RBI is India's central bank, and it regulates monetary policies, operates under the Government of India, and undertakes various initiatives for the financial sector.
